text:
alex: Thinking out loud — we should add a per-tenant retention flag tied to routing policy edits so customers can opt to keep full evidence for certain orgs. e.g. feature flag 'retain_evidence_for_compliance' that flips richer audit payloads.
jamie: sounds useful. can we show that on the timeline UI as a pill so admins know which changes will be archived long-term? :eyes:
sara: main ops concern is export size. if we always keep full KV/cache snapshots for flagged orgs we could multiply storage. need sampling + TTL rules.
mike: agree on cost. proposal: retain full evidence only for changes marked by policy tag + an explicit justification field. default still compact diffs. we can expose a toggle in console + API param on change POST.
alex: API contract idea — when a change is recorded we emit to both: 1) console timeline (rich), 2) NDJSON export (compact by default), 3) webhook (rich only if tenant flag enabled). That way SIEM customers get full events via webhook if they opted in.
jamie: what's the webhook schema? we should standardize attribution fields so downstream can map actor -> id/email without leaking sensitive tokens.
mike: draft schema in thread: ```json
{
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "tid",
  "change": {"type": "routing.policy.update", "diff": "ndjson-diff-or-compact"},
  "actor": {"id": "acct-1234", "display_name": "sally@example.com", "role": "admin"},
  "justification": "string (optional)",
  "retain_evidence": true,
  "links": {"console_url": "https://console/redwood/..."}
}
```
jamie: we should add an actor_pseudonym when tenant has PII-redaction enabled (to avoid sending emails to external SIEMs). legal?
legal: yup — must support redaction. webhook should include two fields: actor.display_name_redacted and actor.pseudonym_hash. Only full display_name if tenant consents. record consent in tenant settings + audit trail.
sara: also need backpressure behavior: large events should get enqueued to export queue and not block the change path. add a per-tenant export quota and an alert if webhook failures > 5% for 10m.
mike: implementation plan: 1) add tenant flag + justification text on API, 2) emit compact change synchronously, enqueue rich evidence generation job async, 3) wire webhook to a retry/backoff queue with per-tenant quotas, 4) expose console badge "EVIDENCE: retained" and a hover tooltip linking to export logs.
alex: for timeline UX — show inline delta preview for compact diffs, and a "Download full evidence" CTA when retain_evidence is true (respecting RBAC). also show a small icon if evidence was sent to webhook (green dot).
jamie: question: should NDJSON export include pseudonym_hash or the full actor id? some customers want mapping but legal wants redaction. maybe allow mapping via an enterprise key exchange (KMS-backed) so customer can decode pseudonym locally.
legal: we can offer a mapping service only under EULA + key exchange. default is redact. also log that mapping requests were performed for compliance.
sara: telemetry: emit metric audit.export.bytes, audit.export.failures, audit.retained.count per tenant. add console alerting rule template: alert if audit.export.failures_rate > 0.05 over 10m.
mike: rollout plan: feature-flag the retention on Dedicated first, beta in hosted for select customers. add a canary where 1% of changes get full evidence in a test tenant to validate performance.

alex: thanks. action items: mike to write webhook schema PR, sara to spec backpressure quotas, jamie to design timeline pill and CTA, legal to draft redaction policy. I'll collate and put in a GH issue.
jamie: adding GH issue now and pinging beta customers for feedback. :rocket:
